context: Attach a system profile in the DataFrame adapter family the same way base/adapter.py does for SQL, so both hierarchies produce the same client_host block. Prefer lifting the profile collection to a point both families share over duplicating the call into each of the five DataFrame adapters.
description:
Every DataFrame result publishes an environment block containing only platform_runtime. No client_host is recorded: no os, arch, python, cpu_count, memory_gb or CPU identity. Verified across the whole archive -- 0 of 107 sampled raw DataFrame results carry client_host.arch, and all 43 DataFrame bundles in the published corpus (pandas 15, polars 19, read_primitives 4, pyspark 2, tpch_skew 3) lack it. Every SQL run has it; no DataFrame run does.

Root cause is structural, not a missing call. The SQL adapters descend from benchbox/platforms/base/adapter.py, whose _build_execution_metadata calls get_system_info() and attaches the result as system_profile. The DataFrame adapters descend from a separate hierarchy (ExpressionFamilyAdapter / PandasFamilyAdapter) that never runs that path, so result.system_profile stays unset and _build_environment_block emits an empty client_host that _compact then drops.

Found while validating CPU identity capture for #1948/#1951. Once #1951 lands, DataFrame runs do gain cpu_model and cpu_vendor -- but only because from_system_profile's detection fallback fires when the profile is wholly absent, which is exactly the symptom. They still record no host, so ~28% of the corpus stays blank on every hardware axis.

preserves.behavior: A DataFrame result must record the same client_host fields a SQL result does: os, arch, python, cpu_count, memory_gb, cpu_model, cpu_vendor.
Detection must stay at capture time only; the load path must never stamp the re-deriving machine's hardware onto a stored result.
Existing DataFrame bundles must keep loading unchanged; this adds capture, it does not alter historical data.

work_units.summary: Pin the gap - enumerate which adapters and which fields, from the raw archive and the published corpus
Attach the system profile in the DataFrame adapter family
Assert SQL and DataFrame runs produce the same client_host field set
